  3. Direct spectral method — no iterative-convergence concern (CGLS is still slowly reducing its residual at iter 135).
  4. Consistent with the other two methods (cosine 0.732 / 0.918).
  5. Moderate norm (4.242): smoother than Tikhonov (5.501), less over-smoothed than CGLS (3.458).
  Tikhonov(GCV) is a strong alternative; the three form a robust consensus.
